rows.text: with `o` = `rcx`: `v` = `007B2470(&stack qword holding qword [o+0x28])`; returns 0 in `al` when qword [o+0x18] is 0 or `v`'s vtable slot +0x20 returns 0 in `al`; returns 1 when `v`'s slot +8 returns other than 2; returns 0 when qword [v+0xA8] is non-zero; otherwise calls `007D0600(o+0x10, &p, dword [o+0x638])` on a zeroed 16-byte stack pair `p` and, for i from 0 while i is below byte [qword [p+8] + 5] (both re-read each step), takes `e` = `007D03B0(&p, &stack q, i)` and `x` = `007E3040(v, word [qword [e+8] + 4])` (then stores `01CB5D88` at q), returning 0 when `x` is null or `007E2F90(x)` is below 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`; comiss/jb, so NaN also returns 0); returns 1 after the loop (stack cookie `01F44830` checked by `00808C40`)
